summary: Public receipt mode grants executed passing work evidence to skipped and failing todo node:test oracles
evidence: Temporary public CLI fixtures using the same serial runner and testMatch as test/receipts.test.ts: test.skip with an assertion 42===99 and failing test.todo both produce observations kind=pass executed=true, problems=[], and orientation unverifiedCompletedWork=[] after an explicit edge. Reproducer /tmp/coherence-receipt-adversarial-probe.mjs.

summary: Renaming a surviving incomplete verification start into the pending namespace silently removes it from receipt inventory
evidence: beginReceipt followed by rename starts/<run>.json to starts/.pending-<run> changes listReceipts incomplete from [run] to []; bytes survive and no refusal occurs. No false pass is granted. Reproducer /tmp/coherence-receipt-storage-probe.mjs.

summary: A recent prior batch report becomes witnessed receipt evidence after the current runner exits before testing
evidence: Public CLI fixture: testBatch node broken-runner.js --outputFile=report.json; runner only prints initialization failure and exits 1. A pre-existing passing Vitest report younger than two seconds yields verify --receipt exit 0, executed=true and problems=[]. Aging the identical report ten seconds makes the claim skip. Reproducer /tmp/coherence-receipt-batch-probe.mjs.

summary: Receipt execution flag loses witnessed failures after positive-only execution callback repair
evidence: Public serial receipt probe runs assert.equal(42,99): Node TAP reports not ok, assertion stack, fail 1 and exit 1, but receipt records kind=fail executed=false. Reproducer /tmp/coherence-receipt-serial-repair-probe.mjs. No false verification credit; negative execution evidence is mislabeled.

summary: Concurrent receipt input sampling captures another verifier temporary status output as source change
evidence: Two concurrent public CLI runs produced one after manifest containing only one extra path .coherence/status-79f2fc73-fc7b-4bf3-aab7-c4db6cd046d0.tmp; the seven input files were otherwise byte-identical. Receipt reports inputs changed during execution from verifier-owned atomic status publication. Retained in /tmp/coherence-receipt-batch-repair-probe.json zero-no-output fixture artifacts.
